rows.name: Welcome / Empty
rows.notes: Product welcome/suggestions seam; preserve prompts and number of suggestions.

rows.name: Assistant message
rows.notes: Project composition wraps upstream MessagePrimitive. Override whole semantic component only when authorized; no inner DOM rework.

rows.name: User message
rows.notes: Preserve message/branch/edit controls and attachments.

rows.name: Markdown / code / list / table / blockquote
rows.notes: Typography/inherited foreground; code token coloring separate from brand state. Do not restructure parser output.

rows.name: Composer
rows.notes: Product-owned semantic child seams over upstream Composer primitives; muted/background/border/input/ring/primary.

rows.name: Send / Cancel
rows.notes: Use primary/ring tokens and preserve conditional runtime controls.

rows.name: Attachment / upload
rows.notes: File/image lifecycle belongs to upstream. Token styling only; do not invent attachment behavior.

rows.name: Quote block / preview / toolbar
rows.notes: Foreground alpha, background/border. Preserve selection portal and quote lifecycle.

rows.name: Message actions
rows.notes: Button primitives; show meaningful actions in their existing placement.

rows.name: Response footer
rows.notes: Product response grouping; preserve one footer per response and branch behavior.

rows.name: Thread list / New / active / actions
rows.notes: Sidebar/accent/muted/ring; product item composition preserves upstream primitives. Native action popup internals are sensitive.

rows.name: AgentPlan
rows.notes: foreground/80 progress, foreground/35 checks, /40 completed, /90 active. Avoid per-li nth-child selectors. Preserve steps/progress.

rows.name: AgentStatus
rows.notes: Shared paper uses background/popover/border. Working blue, completed emerald. SVG/internal dot is sensitive; public root hook alone does not name active dot.

rows.name: JobProgress
rows.notes: Running blue; success emerald; partial amber; error red. Preserve progress semantics and cancellation.

rows.name: Reasoning group
rows.notes: Upstream reasoning.tsx has further hooks. Foreground alpha, collapsed anatomy and scroll/fade internals preserved.

rows.name: Task group / tray
rows.notes: Product transcript adapter around upstream nested task shell. Do not style nested runtime content through fragile chains.

rows.name: Subagent list
rows.notes: Public deterministic presentation; shared live blue helper may be inherited.

rows.name: Tool group
rows.notes: Foreground alpha; preserve grouped disclosure and runtime child ordering.

rows.name: Tool fallback / approval
rows.notes: Token-only inner styling; tool execution approval/receipt state is sensitive. Preserve action count and safety semantics.

rows.name: ToolCall / SearchFiles
rows.notes: Foreground alpha, shared paper and codeSurface. Request/result sections retained.

rows.name: Web search
rows.notes: Foreground alpha and ShimmerLabel. Tokens do not directly introduce Violet accent.

rows.name: Retrieval chunks
rows.notes: foreground text; blue-500/70 relevance meter. Preserve score and result density.

rows.name: Source / citation-like
rows.notes: Muted/foreground plus info blue variant. Actual URL/source UI; no invented footnote badges.

rows.name: File result
rows.notes: Preserve download filename/MIME and layout.

rows.name: Image / zoom
rows.notes: Portal bridge and preview lifecycle sensitive. No standalone public ConversationImage export.

rows.name: QuestionFlow / ask_user_question
rows.notes: Product step orchestration uses foreground alpha; OptionList is still upstream-owned, error red. Root step orchestration has no dedicated data-slot.

rows.name: Mention trigger / results
rows.notes: Product matching/provider async errors plus upstream trigger panel. Keep loading/empty/error/retry distinctions.

rows.name: Slash trigger / result
rows.notes: Action vs directive behavior preserved; do not invent toolbar buttons.

rows.name: Chart / DataMessageUI
rows.notes: var(--border), --muted, --chart-1. Product source can change visual treatment, preserve values.

rows.name: Frontend tool form / dialog
rows.notes: Optional demos not active here. Preserve capability vs transcript receipt distinction; copy via frontendTools locale.

rows.name: Dialog / Popover / Tooltip
rows.notes: background/popover/foreground/overlay/border/ring. Portal positioners and arrows Level 4 internals; do not override geometry.

rows.name: Button / Input / Badge / NativeSelect
rows.notes: Use semantic tokens. NativeSelect snapshot lives in internal/primitives, not vendor directory. No standalone public Card found.

rows.name: Generative UI / A2UI
rows.notes: Installable optional integrations, not loaded in inspected default AppUIModel. No screenshot baseline; do not assume rendering.
